Our Story

A Garden Retreat in the Hills

Nestled among green hills and lush lawns, every corner of Namohills is built for easy, honest comfort — peaceful rooms, open-air dining and a turf made for a great game with friends and family.

Set across acres of manicured gardens, Namohills Resort & Garden brings together comfortable stays, warm Indian hospitality and open green spaces for travellers who want more than a hotel room — they want a retreat.

Floodlit Turf

Private Banquet Lawns
